Facebook AI Responds to Crisis Response Post With Tone Deaf Crisis Response:
OWEN SCOTT MUIR, M.D.
NOV 7, 2022
36

Can’t make this stuff up! Apparently, writing about the state of our crisis response system has alarmed Facebook’s bots. And their response is painfully stupid: “Support yourself in a crisis”…#metapointmade, literally and figuratively…
